profile.value_proposition: A small studio that gets independent food and drink brands shelf-ready: identity, packaging and print in one place.

pages./: Kiln & Co Studio. Branding and packaging design for independent food and drink. We are a five-person design studio in Manchester's Northern Quarter. Get in touch to talk about your launch.
pages./services: What we do. We name, brand and package products for bakeries, distillers, coffee roasters, restaurants and street food traders who are ready to move from a market stall to a retail shelf. Services: brand identity, packaging design, menus and signage, launch artwork. We work with founders and marketing managers directly.
pages./case-studies: Our work. A full rebrand for Pollen Bakery ahead of its second shop. Bottle and label design for Three Rivers Gin, now stocked in forty independent retailers. Wayfinding and signage for Hatch Street Food Market.
pages./pricing: Pricing. Projects typically start at £2,500. A full identity and packaging range is usually between £6,000 and £15,000. We are a small studio and do not take on national chains or agencies looking for white-label work.

ground_truth: Independent UK food and drink producers and hospitality operators (bakeries, distilleries, breweries, coffee roasters, restaurants, street food brands, delis), roughly 2-50 staff, in the North West first and the rest of the UK second, that sell a physical product or run venues and need branding or packaging. Not design studios, agencies, printers or freelancers; not national chains with in-house design teams; not businesses outside food, drink and hospitality.
